annotations.title: Request a tool Agent402 does not have

description: [free] Report a capability the 500+ tools do not cover, after catalog.search or catalog.find found nothing that fits. Requests are clustered by need, and frequent ones get built. Records demand only: it runs nothing. Same intake as POST https://agent402.tools/api/wish; aggregate demand is public at https://agent402.tools/api/wishes.

context.description: Optional: what you were trying to accomplish, or the input you had - helps disambiguate similar-sounding requests.

need.description: What you needed and could not find, in plain language, e.g. "convert a HEIC image to JPEG" or "look up a UK company by registration number"
